english.title: Fail to comply with duty to find out about changes in PSC information
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were

(B)_[an officer of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..),]_

to which Part 21A of the Companies Act 2006 applied which knew or had cause to believe that there had been a change in the required particulars of a registrable

(C)_[person,]_
(D)_[relevant legal entity,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON OR LEGAL ENTITY..), in relation to the company but had not had confirmation that the change had occurred or had not had confirmation of all of the information that the company would need to include in a notice of the change under section

(J)_[790LE(1)]_
